description: Suggests meals at restaurants near coordinates supplied by the user, from meal combinations saved in Enshape, optionally filtered by query, maxCalories or minProtein. Returns at most 10 suggestions plus nearbyRestaurants chains within the radius with distance, saved nutrition, serving info, component items and a notification-free logFoodReference. Suggest savedTargetMode: "meal_share" with date when personalizing one meal. Menu freshness is unknown, so the user must check the official current menu. Location is not stored. Consumes one shared diary call. Never writes.

date.description: With useSavedTargets, the user’s local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Scores against saved daily targets minus what the diary already holds for that date.

excludedRestaurants.description: Restaurant chains to leave out, by name. Case and punctuation are ignored; partial names do not match.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place to search around, in degrees, given by the user. Never guess it from the device, IP address or a place name.

limit.description: Number of meal suggestions to return. Defaults to 5, maximum 10.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place to search around, in degrees, given by the user.

minProtein.description: Optional minimum protein grams per meal.

query.description: Optional dish, cuisine or restaurant filter words (e.g. "grilled chicken" or "Chipotle").

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 10, maximum 25.

savedTargetMode.description: With useSavedTargets: whole_day (default) scores against the daily totals (minus the diary when date is given); meal_share scores against one meal’s share as the Enshape app does: a third of each daily target, capped by what is left that date when date is given.

targets.description: Nutrition goals for this one meal, in calories and grams. All five values are required. Omit for unpersonalized suggestions.

useSavedTargets.description: Personalize with the connected account’s saved DAILY targets. Only true opts in. These are whole-day totals, not a per-meal budget, unless date is also given or savedTargetMode is meal_share.

name: get_nearby_meal_suggestions
title: Suggest meals at nearby restaurants
